question: How many orders have a pickup slot today, counting every status including cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12'

question: How many SKUs are out of stock right now?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE on_hand = 0

question: Which aisle has the most out-of-stock SKUs?
gold_sql: SELECT aisle FROM inventory WHERE on_hand = 0 GROUP BY aisle ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have a vegan dietary preference?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE dietary_preference = 'vegan'

question: Break down today's open orders by status: how many are received, picking and staged?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12' AND status IN ('received','picking','staged') GROUP BY status

question: How many distinct customers have an order with a pickup slot today?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12'

question: How many orders were cancelled in total across all the data?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: Which brand has the most out-of-stock SKUs?
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand FROM inventory i JOIN products p USING (sku) WHERE i.on_hand = 0 GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many organic products do we carry, and how many of them are in stock (on_hand > 0)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.on_hand > 0) FROM products p JOIN inventory i USING (sku) WHERE p.is_organic

question: How many produce SKUs are low on stock, meaning between 1 and 5 units on hand?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN inventory i USING (sku) WHERE p.category = 'produce' AND i.on_hand BETWEEN 1 AND 5

question: Which order with a pickup slot today has the highest total_amount? Give the order id.
gold_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12' ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders are there for each pickup hour today (hour of pickup_slot_start, all statuses)?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM pickup_slot_start)::int, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12' GROUP BY 1

question: How many order items need attention right now across all orders (pending and the SKU's on-hand is below the ordered quantity)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN inventory i USING (sku) WHERE oi.pick_status = 'pending' AND i.on_hand < oi.quantity

question: What is the single best-selling product by units ordered across all non-cancelled orders? Give its name.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING (sku) JOIN orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which product subcategory has had the most order items with pick_status 'substituted'?
gold_sql: SELECT p.subcategory FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING (sku) WHERE oi.pick_status = 'substituted' GROUP BY p.subcategory ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the overall substitution acceptance rate, as a percentage rounded to 1 decimal place?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'approved') / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('approved','rejected')), 1) FROM substitution_proposals

question: Which customers placed more than 5 orders? Give first name and last initial with their order counts.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_initial, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_initial HAVING COUNT(*) > 5

question: What percentage of order items in non-cancelled orders were removed? Round to 1 decimal place.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.pick_status = 'removed') / COUNT(*), 1) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'

question: In the dairy category, what is the average price of store-brand products versus non-store-brand products? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT is_store_brand, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM products WHERE category = 'dairy' GROUP BY is_store_brand

question: How many vegan customers have ordered at least one non-household product that is not vegan?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o USING (customer_id) JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id) JOIN products p USING (sku) WHERE c.dietary_preference = 'vegan' AND p.category <> 'household' AND NOT p.is_vegan

question: How many orders were picked up on each day from 2026-10-06 through 2026-10-11 (by pickup slot date)?
gold_sql: SELECT pickup_slot_start::date, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'picked_up' AND pickup_slot_start::date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-06' AND DATE '2026-10-11' GROUP BY 1

question: What was the sum of total_amount for orders picked up with a pickup slot on 2026-10-11? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'picked_up' AND pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-11'

question: What is the average order value (total_amount) of picked-up orders, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'picked_up'

question: On average, how many hours ahead of the pickup slot start are orders placed? Use all orders and round to 1 decimal.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pickup_slot_start - placed_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 1) FROM orders

question: How many SKUs do not appear in any order with a pickup slot today?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING (order_id) WHERE oi.sku = p.sku AND o.pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12')

question: Which items in order 354 need attention? Give the order item ids.
gold_sql: SELECT oi.order_item_id FROM order_items oi JOIN inventory i USING (sku) WHERE oi.order_id = 354 AND oi.pick_status = 'pending' AND i.on_hand < oi.quantity

question: What is the median total_amount of picked-up orders, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_amount))::numeric, 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'picked_up'

question: Which product category has the highest average quantity per order line?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING (sku) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY AVG(oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders with a pickup slot starting in the next 2 hours still have at least one item that needs attention?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id) JOIN inventory i USING (sku) WHERE o.status IN ('received','picking') AND o.pickup_slot_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-12 13:30:00-05' AND o.pickup_slot_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-12 15:30:00-05' AND oi.pick_status = 'pending' AND i.on_hand < oi.quantity

question: For each remaining pickup slot today (slot starts after the current time), how many orders are not yet staged (received or picking)?
gold_sql: SELECT pickup_slot_start, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE pickup_slot_start > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-12 13:30:00-05' AND pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12' AND status IN ('received','picking') GROUP BY pickup_slot_start

question: What is the total dollar value at risk today: quantity times unit price of all items needing attention in today's received or picking orders? Round to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id) JOIN inventory i USING (sku) WHERE o.status IN ('received','picking') AND o.pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12' AND oi.pick_status = 'pending' AND i.on_hand < oi.quantity

question: Among items needing attention in today's received or picking orders, how many units are short in each subcategory? Units short = quantity minus on_hand.
gold_sql: SELECT p.subcategory, SUM(oi.quantity - i.on_hand) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id) JOIN inventory i USING (sku) JOIN products p USING (sku) WHERE o.status IN ('received','picking') AND o.pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12' AND oi.pick_status = 'pending' AND i.on_hand < oi.quantity GROUP BY p.subcategory

question: How many items needing attention in today's received or picking orders have allow_substitution = false?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id) JOIN inventory i USING (sku) WHERE o.status IN ('received','picking') AND o.pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12' AND oi.pick_status = 'pending' AND i.on_hand < oi.quantity AND NOT oi.allow_substitution

question: Which customers with any dietary preference have an order still to be picked today (status received or picking)? Give first name, last initial, their preference and the order id.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_initial, c.dietary_preference, o.order_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id) WHERE c.dietary_preference IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN ('received','picking') AND o.pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12'

question: How many order items have pick_status 'substituted' but no approved substitution proposal?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.pick_status = 'substituted' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM substitution_proposals sp WHERE sp.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id AND sp.status = 'approved')

question: Which product category, by the original item's category, has the lowest substitution acceptance rate (approved over approved plus rejected)?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category FROM substitution_proposals sp JOIN order_items oi USING (order_item_id) JOIN products p ON p.sku = oi.sku GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sp.status = 'approved')::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sp.status IN ('approved','rejected')), 0) ASC LIMIT 1

question: What share of all orders were placed by customers who have any dietary preference? Give a percentage rounded to 1 decimal.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.dietary_preference IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id)

question: Which out-of-stock SKUs are in the most pending order items today? List the top 3 SKUs with the number of pending items, only today's received or picking orders.
gold_sql: SELECT oi.sku, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id) JOIN inventory i USING (sku) WHERE i.on_hand = 0 AND oi.pick_status = 'pending' AND o.status IN ('received','picking') AND o.pickup_slot_start::date = DATE '2026-10-12' GROUP BY oi.sku ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, oi.sku LIMIT 3

question: For orders picked up between 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-11, what percentage of their order lines were picked in full (pick_status 'picked')? Round to 1 decimal.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oi.pick_status = 'picked') / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id) WHERE o.status = 'picked_up' AND o.pickup_slot_start::date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-06' AND DATE '2026-10-11'

question: Which customer has the highest total spend (sum of total_amount) across their picked-up orders? Give first name, last initial and the amount rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_initial, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING (customer_id) WHERE o.status = 'picked_up' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_initial ORDER BY SUM(o.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 1
